title: Knowledge Graph Decisions
description: Temporal entity-relationship triples for tracking architectural decision validity. Max 50 triples. Managed by scripts/knowledge-graph/

id.description: Unique identifier, typically 'adr-NNN' matching the ADR file

subject.description: The entity or concept this decision is about

predicate.description: The relationship type (uses, implements, prefers, rejects, etc.)

object.description: The value or target of the relationship

validFrom.description: ISO date when this decision became active

validTo.description: ISO date when superseded, or null if still active

source.description: File path of the originating ADR
